programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Des Racines et des ailes - Passion Patrimoine
programme.sub-title: Sur les rives de la Garonne
programme.desc: Des Pyrenees espagnoles ou elle prend sa source, au vaste estuaire de la Gironde ou elle se jette, la Garonne parcourt plus de 600 kilometres a travers le Comminges, l'Agenais ou l'Entre-deux-Mers. Le fleuve evolue au cours de ce long voyage. L'apport de ses affluents, comme la Neste, l'Ariege, le Tarn et le Lot, modifie son visage. A bord d'un helicoptere, Didier Taillefer part en Espagne pour faire des photos aeriennes de l'une des principales sources du fleuve : le Trou du Toro. Ce site exceptionnel est situe au pied du massif de la Maladeta, ou la Garonne disparaît sous terre avant de reapparaître au Val d'Artan. Au coeur des Pyrenees, le fleuve donne naissance a un jardin de Cocagne : le Comminges. Dans le village de Huos, Remy Martin a amenage un verger-potager bio sur un ancien meandre.

Forced to accept her circumstance, Nimfa becomes an imposer so Rosette and Jeremy can get away with their affair.

programme.title: Hippos, Israel
programme.desc: Hippos (Sussita) est une ancienne ville greco-romaine situee sur une colline surplombant la mer de Galilee dans le nord d’Israel. Fondee a l’epoque hellenistique, elle a prospere en tant que partie de la Decapole et est aujourd’hui connue pour ses impressionnantes ruines, ses rues, ses temples, sa basilique et ses portes de ville, temoignant d’un riche melange de culture classique et d’histoire chretienne ancienne.

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Sudáfrica
programme.desc: Savane Sauvage. Desde las montañas Drakensberg hasta el océano Índico, pasando por la sabana, la expedición The Explorers sigue el rastro de los "Cinco Grandes" y su salvaje procesión.

programme.title: Le Grand Inventaire de la Planète: Arctique Canadien
programme.desc: Le règne du blanc. Les membres de l'expédition The Explorers partent à la découverte de l'Arctique canadien, une région emblématique du bouleversement climatique qui touche notre planète. Pour être au plus près d'une civilisation et d'une nature en pleine mutation, pour témoigner de l'évolution de la vie sur ces terres glaciales, l'expédition a parcouru le Grand Nord Canadien, du printemps au début de l'hiver.

programme.title: Site de bapteme de Yardenit, Israel
programme.desc: Le site de baptême de Yardenit est un lieu paisible et sacre situe sur le fleuve Jourdain dans le nord d’Israel. Reconnu comme un site traditionnel associe au baptême de Jesus, il accueille des pelerins du monde entier pour la reflexion spirituelle, la priere et les ceremonies de baptême dans un cadre naturel serein.

programme.title: Encuentros Que Generan Bienestar

programme.title: Un Amor Duradero

programme.title: Evil in the Woods
programme.desc: A group of three young people go into the forest, having heard that there is a stone altar, they search until late at night and suddenly a young woman disappears from the group. The two men stay in the forest but can't find her. Initially, Malte Wirtz had wanted to shoot a romantic comedy in Cologne's Königsforst.

programme.title: Les Chemins De L'ecole

programme.desc: Ces enfants vivent aux quatre coins du globe mais partagent la meme soif d’apprendre. Ils ont compris que seule l’instruction leur permettra d’ameliorer leur vie, et c’est pour cela que chaque jour, dans des paysages incroyables, ils se lancent dans un periple a haut risque qui les conduira vers le savoir.

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Islas Marquesas

programme.title: Le Grand Inventaire de la Planète: Nouvelle Calédonie, au Pays des Merveilles de la Terre
programme.desc: The Explorers, menée par Olivier Chiabodo, a déployé ses équipes pour réaliser, en images, l’inventaire des merveilles naturelles d'une terre découverte par l’explorateur anglais James Cook en 1774 : la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Mais également découvrir la culture des premiers habitants de l'île, les Mélanésiens.

programme.title: Amor Musical
programme.desc: Todo inicia cuando son transferidos a la escuela Jung San que recibe auspicio por parte de una fundación millonaria y poderosa. Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Siste løp i Superbike 2017!

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Roadracing med Steffen og Team Kaos

programme.title: Garasjen - Kim Jannike sin BMW, Grensetreffet i Halden og nytt eksosanlegg!
programme.desc: Kim Jannike har bygget seg en BMW, og denne skal brukes i drifting, men når hun skal prøvekjøre bilen med Asgeir går ikke alt som planlagt. Det er også tid for Grensetreffet i Halden, hvor det er mange flotte biler å se på.

programme.title: Garasjen - Spesiell drømmebil, Finnskogfestivalen og en låve full av amcar

programme.title: Garasjen - Nyinnkjøpt Ferrari, Volvo 142 og finale på Finnskogfestivalen
programme.desc: Vi møter vi Ivar og Asgeir. De har kjøpt en Volvo 142, som de skal bygge om til en rask rallybil for å delta i Rallye Monte-Carlo Historique. I Drammen treffer vi Arild Olsen som har kjøpt en Ferrari han ikke har sett på nett.

programme.title: Garasjen - Mekking av både Ferrari og Volvo 142, og et lite lakk kurs

programme.title: Jeg går elektrisk - Jeg går elektrisk...med Skoda Enyaq iV

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1886-1930
programme.desc: Bilen har eksistert i over 100 år, og det har vært en lang vei å gå fra første testkjøring til ABS, Air condition og automatgir. Mer enn et århundre med utvikling, og vogna med motor blir stadig oppgradert til mer sofistikerte biler.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1930-1940

programme.desc: På slutten av 1940 og 1950 går vi mot en ny start. Etter krigen nærmest stoppet bilutviklingen og produksjonen helt opp, men produsenter fra Frankrike, England og USA begynte sakte bygge biler til sivile igjen.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Gran Turismo 7 mit VR-Brille: Sehr geil, aber der Magen rebelliert!
programme.desc: Gran Turismo funktioniert jetzt auch mit der Sony VR2-Brille! Da stürzt Alex sich gleich in die Renn-Action. Allerdings hat er die Rechnung ohne seinen Magen gemacht...

programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Vorfahrt
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Nio Battery-Swap
programme.desc: Der chinesische Autohersteller Nio geht das Thema "E-Auto laden" anders an als die Konkurrenz. In sogenannten Battery-Swap-Stations soll der Akku innerhalb von nur fünf Minuten gewechselt werden. Ist das die Zukunft der Elektromobilität? Alexander Bloch testet die Anlage und klärt die 9 größten Irrtümer zum Akkuwechsel beim E-Auto.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Golf 7
programme.desc: Der VW Golf 7 ist eines der meistverkauften und beliebtesten Modelle des Volkswagenkonzerns. Worauf man beim Kauf eines gebrauchten Golf 7 achten muss erklärt Alexander Bloch. Egal ob Probleme mit dem AGR-Ventil, dem DSG-Getriebe und Rost, die Schwachstellen und guten Seiten des Wolfsburger Dauerbrenners kommen hier zum Vorschein.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - 1.000.000 Kilometer
programme.desc: In der 100. Folge von Bloch erklärt kümmert sich Alex um das Thema Dauerläufer: Wie hält dein Auto ewig? Im Mittelpunkt steht ein Lexus LS400 mit einer Million Kilometer auf der Uhr. Wie fährt sich so ein Kilometerfresser eigentlich? Und was muss man tun, damit das eigene Auto auch das Zeug zum Dauerläufer hat? Alex Bloch erklärt euch 10 wichtige Regeln - das wird gut!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - E-Autos 2023
programme.desc: Die Lieferzeiten bei Elektroautos sind lang. Doch zumindest wird 2023 die Auswahl deutlich größer. Besonders die chinesischen Hersteller wollen angreifen und zeigen zahlreiche Neuheiten. Aber auch die deutschen Produzenten legen nach. Alexander Bloch zeigt seine 10 Highlights für das Jahr 2023. Hier seht ihr seine Favoriten.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Sicherheits-Irrtümer
programme.desc: Welche Autos sind am sichersten? Welche Aussagekraft haben Crashtests überhaupt? Warum spielt die Farbe eines Autos in der Unfallstatistik eine Rolle? Die Antwort auf diese Fragen und weitere spannende Informationen rund um das Thema Verkehrssicherheit gibt es in dieser Folge Bloch erklärt. Zudem findet Alexander Bloch unter den Testdummies einen neuen Freund: Thor!

programme.title: Die 7
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Porsche Taycan im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Porsche hat den Taycan umfangreich überarbeitet und in vielen Disziplinen verbessert. Die Batterie wird größer und kann schneller Laden. Alex Bloch fährt den Basis Taycan mit großer Batterie im E-Auto-Supertest und kommt aus dem Grinsen nicht mehr raus. Wie die Chancen stehen, dass der Taycan auf die Pole Position der Elektroautos fährt, seht ihr im Video.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der MG4 Electric im E-Auto Supertest
programme.desc: Der MG4 schwimmt auf der Erfolgswelle! Der Überflieger befindet sich unter den Top 5 der meistverkauften Elektroautos in Deutschland. Was der chinesischen Kompaktstromer im Vergleich zum Opel Astra Electric und dem VW ID.3 drauf hat, klärt Alexander Bloch.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Opel Astra Electric im EAS
programme.desc: Kein anderes Auto hat Alexander Bloch bisher in ein solches Wechselbad der Gefühle geschmissen. Von „sensationell!“ bis „macht ihr Witze?“ ist alles dabei. Was die Stärken und Schwächen des Opel Astra Electric sind und ob er sich gegen den VW ID.3 behaupten kann, erfahrt ihr hier!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Mercedes E-Actros 600: Die 5 GIGA-Fakten zum neuen Elektro-Truck
programme.desc: Mercedes-Benz Trucks präsentiert den E-Actros 600, einen batterieelektrischen 40-Tonner, der ohne Zwischenladung mehr als 500 Kilometer weit fahren soll. Alexander Bloch durfte sich den Elektro-LKW bereits exklusiv anschauen und erklärt die 5 Giga-Fakten zum neuen Mercedes E-Actros 600.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Sparen mit dem Elektroauto: Das bringt was - und das bringt nichts!
programme.desc: Auch zum Elektroauto gibt es eine Vielzahl an Spartipps. Doch bringen die wirklich was? Alexander Bloch erklärt welche Tipps sinnvoll sind - und welche ihr euch sparen könnt.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Langstreckenstar Hyundai Ioniq 6: Fast wie ein Verbrenner!
programme.desc: Oft fließt die Reichenweitenangst in die Kaufentscheidung von Elektro-Autos ein. Bei Verbrennern stellt sich diese Frage gar nicht: die Reichweiten sind hoch und nach einem fünfminütigen Tankstopp geht es für gewöhnlich weiter. Eignen sich Elektro-Autos auch als Reisebegleiter? Wie viel Reichweite ist wirklich nötig? Und wie viel Zeit muss ich für das Laden einplanen? All das beantwortet Alexander Bloch anhand des Hyundai Ioniq 6.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Ist Drehmoment wichtiger als Leistung? Die 5 größten Irrtümer zu PS & Co.
programme.desc: PS, Kilowatt und Newtonmeter benutzt man häufig, wenn man über Autos spricht. Dabei gibt es hier einige Stolperfallen. Sind PS in allen Ländern gleich? Newtonmeter gibt es nur beim Drehmoment? Alexander Bloch erklärt die 5 größten Irrtümer zu PS, Kilowatt und Co.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Kein Motoröl im E-Auto? 4 Irrtümer zu Öl im Elektroauto
programme.desc: Ein E-Auto braucht kein Öl und schon gar kein Motoröl. Ist das wirklich so? Chief Explanation Officer Alexander Bloch ist ins Forschungs- und Entwicklungszentrum von Petronas Lubricants gefahren, um mit den größten Öl-Irrtümern rund um die Elektromobilität und die Zukunft von Schmier- und Motorölen aufzuräumen.

programme.title: Einzeltest
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - BMW i5: Deutschland kann es doch!
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch bittet den BMW i5 eDrive40 zu einem ersten Check. Im ersten rein elektrischen 5er BMW sorgt der gleiche Elektromotor wie im BMW i4 eDrive40 für Vortrieb. Nun hat die E-Maschine mit mehr Gewicht zu kämpfen. Wie sich das auf die Reichweite und den Verbrauch auswirkt, ermittelt Bloch vor laufender Kamera. Dank Hands-Free-Driving geht das auch ohne Hände am Steuer.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Autonomes Fahren - Blick in die Zukunft mit autoELF
programme.desc: Die autoELF entstand im Projekt UNICARagil - ein autonomes Fahrzeug gemäß Level 4. Um autonom fahren zu können, braucht es viele verschiedene Sensoren - und die sind teuer. Alex Bloch lässt sich mit verschiedenen Manövern über die Teststrecke chauffieren und bespricht im Interview mit Prof. Dr.-Ing. Steven Peters die autonome Zukunft.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Die 5 Todsünden auf den ersten 1.000 km
programme.desc: Man hat lange gewartet und endlich ist es soweit: der Neuwagen ist da! Am liebsten würde man jetzt sofort ordentlich Gas geben. Aber Moment mal, war da nicht irgendwas? So ein neues Auto muss doch erst eingefahren werden, oder? Alexander Bloch erklärt, was auf den ersten 1.000 Kilometern zu beachten ist: Motor, Turbo, Bremsen, Dämpfer, Reifen - es gibt eine Menge zu tun.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - E-Auto-Highlights 2024: Auch ohne Förderung ein gutes Jahr
programme.desc: Auch 2024 kürt Alex Bloch wieder seine E-Auto-Highlights. Hier seht ihr die Top-Neuheiten: Günstig, schnell, viel Platz oder Offroad-tauglich. Hier ist für jeden etwas dabei!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Straße weiß, Akku leer? 4 E-Auto Winter-Mythen
programme.desc: Wenn es draußen frostig und kalt ist, kommt man mit dem E-Auto nur noch halb soweit und auch das Aufladen dauert doppelt so lang. Ist das wirklich so? Eisbär Alexander Bloch räumt mit den 4 gängigsten Winter-Mythen zu E-Autos auf.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Renault R5 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Der Renault 5 feiert sein Comeback: Als elektrischer Kleinwagen im Retro-Design. Doch Optik ist nicht alles. Alexander Bloch prüft im E-Auto-Supertest, was der neue R5 bei Technik, Komfort und Platzangebot drauf hat. Auch Verbrauch, Reichweite und Dynamik stehen im Fokus. Ist der Renault 5 zurecht zum Auto des Jahres 2025 gewählt worden?

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der VW ID.7 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Der ID.7 stellt die vierte Stufe der Elektromobilität bei VW dar. Die Fünf-Meter-Limo kommt mit einem neuen Elektromotor, neuen Features und Software und einer verbesserten Aerodynamik daher. Ob der ID.7 das beste Elektroauto unter 100.000 Euro im Supertest werden kann und damit den BWW i4 eDrive 40 entthront, prüft Alex im E-Auto Supertest.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Ford Explorer im Supertest – Wie gut ist er wirklich?
programme.desc: Der neue Ford Explorer mit 77 kWh Akku und Heckantrieb steht im Elektroauto-Supertest! Wie schlägt er sich in Effizienz, Qualität, Dynamik und Komfort? Ist er eine echte Alternative zu VW? Alex Bloch nimmt ihn genau unter die Lupe. Jetzt anschauen!

programme.title: Taking Earth - Caccia Sulla Terra

Presto si rivela alle autorità in allarme che lo scopo di questa forza superiore è quello di trovare un solo uomo su 7 miliardi. L'unico in grado di sconfiggerli per sempre.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News
programme.desc: Hot Corn Cine News è un appuntamento bisettimanale, nato dall’unione tra LoveTv Channel e The Hot Corn, che racconta tutte le novità del mondo del cinema, tra ospiti, eventi e interviste, prossime uscite in sala e cronache mondane. Ad introdurci in questo mondo di news sulla Settima Arte, Irene Cortese e Sara Scarsella. In questa puntata di Hot Corn Cine News vedremo Sara Scarsella al Bellaria Film Festival con alcune interviste esclusive realizzate durante il festival. Parleremo inoltre di In U...

programme.title: Blackout - Invasion Earth
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, la Russia viene colpita da un blackout. Ogni comunicazione è interrotta, le città sono al buio. Nella nuova e inquietante dimensione d'isolamento milioni di persone impazziscono e muoiono per cause sconosciute. Chi si nasconde dietro il disfacimento della nazione e il collasso del mondo intero? A una squadra di eroi, il compito di salvare quel che rimane dell'umanità.

programme.title: Martian Land - Tempesta Su Marte
programme.desc: Nel futuro, la razza umana si è trasferita su Marte e vive in città simili a quelle terrestri, ma protette da enormi campi di forza. Quando una gigantesca tempesta di sabbia sfonda la cupola e distrugge completamente Mars New York, gli abitanti di Mars Los Angeles dovranno cercare di fermare la tempesta, prima di essere i prossimi ad essere spazzati via.

programme.title: Alien Siege
programme.desc: Dopo che un'astronave ha distrutto Washington, D.C., i residenti di una piccola città devono combattere un'unità di soldati alieni che danno la caccia al Presidente degli Stati Uniti e al misterioso dispositivo che sta trasportando, dopo che l'elicottero con cui stava fuggendo atterra proprio nelle vicinanze di quella cittadina.

programme.title: Countdown: Armageddon
programme.desc: Thriller adrenalinico diretto da A.F. Silver che racconta la storia di Alison, una giornalista alle prese con strani eventi che minacciano il pianeta: tornado e terremoti si abbattono sulla Terra, distruggendone rapidamente ogni angolo. Le cose si complicano quando la sua giovane figlia scompare in Israele. Mentre la cerca disperatamente, Alison scopre che dietro gli eventi che si stanno susseguendo, e al rapimento, c’è una setta che vuole scatenare un’Apocalisse. Riuscirà a smascherare il grand...

programme.title: Attacco Alieno Su Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nel Febbraio del 1942 un oggetto non identificato cade su Los Angeles. Settant'anni dopo gli alieni tornano per completare l'attacco attraverso una grande navicella spaziale atterrata sulla città. Le forze armate di Los Angeles rimangono sconvolte in quanto i loro missili non rispondono più ai comandi. Chi la spunterà?

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, un virus di proporzioni epiche ha devastato il pianeta Terra, dove il numero degli infetti supera quello delle persone sane e l'unica speranza è trovare una cura per sconfiggere l'epidemia. La dottoressa Lauren Chase ha un obiettivo ben preciso: portare la sua squadra sul campo e salvare il maggior numero di sopravvissuti.

programme.title: Age Of Tomorrow
programme.desc: La Terra è invasa da Ufo che distruggono tutto quello che si muove. Mentre la battaglia infuria, un gruppo di astronauti riesce a entrare nella nave principale dove uno di loro scopre un portale che conduce al mondo degli alieni. Riesce appena ad avvertire qualcuno dei suoi superiori sulla Terra, prima che tutto il gruppo venga ucciso. Parte l'ultimo disperato tentativo per fermare l'invasione.

programme.title: Taking Earth - Caccia Sulla Terra
programme.desc: Elettrizzante film fantascientifico. La razza umana è in pericolo. Un'invasione aliena sta gettando l'intero pianeta nel caos e nella paura. Presto si rivela alle autorità in allarme che lo scopo di questa forza superiore è quello di trovare un solo uomo su 7 miliardi. L'unico in grado di sconfiggerli per sempre.

programme.title: Blackout - Invasion Earth
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, la Russia viene colpita da un blackout. Ogni comunicazione è interrotta, le città sono al buio. Nella nuova e inquietante dimensione d'isolamento milioni di persone impazziscono e muoiono per cause sconosciute. Chi si nasconde dietro il disfacimento della nazione e il collasso del mondo intero? A una squadra di eroi, il compito di salvare quel che rimane dell'umanità.

programme.title: End Of The World
programme.desc: Mentre una massa di tempeste solari provoca tsunami, vulcani e inondazioni, una famiglia tenta di fuggire dalla città verso la relativa salvezza in un gruppo di grotte ad alta quota a diverse miglia di distanza dall'occhio del ciclone.

programme.title: Global Meltdown
programme.desc: Global Meltdown

programme.title: Airplane Vs. Volcano
programme.desc: Un aereo di linea rimane intrappolato all'interno di un anello di vulcani in eruzione. I passeggeri e l'equipaggio devono trovare un modo per sopravvivere ad alta quota, senza atterrare. Quando, però, la lava e le ceneri scatenano paura e sfiducia tra tutti, non sono solo i vulcani a essere pericolosi. Tutti devono imparare a collaborare se vogliono sopravvivere a questo epico volo di fuoco.

programme.title: 20.0 Megaquake
programme.desc: Mentre un mega-terremoto minaccia San Francisco, una serie di scosse di preavviso crea scompiglio in tutta la città. Una squadra d'élite di esperti di servizi di emergenza e di catastrofi converge sull'epicentro previsto, lavorando instancabilmente per salvare quante più vite possibili prima che la città venga schiacciata nell'oblio.

programme.title: Nature Next Door
programme.sub-title: Nature Next Door - Antarctique, à la Voile entre les Icebergs
programme.desc: Nous suivons des voiliers et un photographe qui naviguent vers l'Antarctique, dans une région où le seul prédateur terrestre est le skua antarctique. Parmi les phoques et les otaries, les manchots empereurs et les baleines à bosse, nous pouvons constater que la relation entre notre espèce et celles qui vivent dans cet univers polaire n'est plus aussi sombre qu'elle l'était autrefois.

programme.title: Nature Next Door
programme.sub-title: Nature Next Door - Islande, sur la Piste du Renard Polaire
programme.desc: C'est une île posée sur un océan glacial, créée par les volcans, sculptée par les glaciers et les cascades. Au cœur de l'été, cette île accueille des millions d'oiseaux, qui malgré leur apparence légère sont incroyablement résistants. Au nord de cette île, on se lance dans une quête : rencontrer et filmer le seul mammifère originaire d'Islande.

programme.title: Nature Next Door
programme.desc: Et si la meilleure option pour rencontrer la faune d'Espagne était d'aller en boîte ? Festoyer avec les vautours, ronger les os avec le gypaète, boire un coup avec les genettes, danser avec les grues cendrées, et poser avec le lynx ibérique.

programme.title: Nature Next Door
programme.sub-title: Nature Next Door - Costa Rica, le Royaume des Colibris
programme.desc: Le Costa Rica est une étroite bande de terre avec de chaque côté un océan. Au centre, d'épaisses forêts et de ténébreux volcans, partout, on y rencontre d'étonnants animaux, qui semblent avoir accepté un peu mieux notre espèce. Des oiseaux multicolores, des reptiles un peu moins discret, mammifères plutôt curieux, partout se livre un fabuleux spectacle de la nature.

programme.title: Nature Next Door
programme.sub-title: Nature Next Door - Maroc, Afrique Extraordinaire, le Continent des Couleurs
programme.desc: Le paysage naturel africain se compose d'une riche palette de couleurs. Pourquoi et comment ces variations de couleurs apparaissent-elles ? Les comprenons-nous, ou recèlent-elles encore de nombreux mystères ?

programme.title: RAZOR：Artificial Vision
programme.desc: Around 40 million people worldwide are blind and a further 250 million are visually impaired. It's a disability that poses extraordinary challenges. At Miguel Hernandez University in Southern Spain, scientists have created a visual neuroprosthesis that's designed to restore a limited but useful sense of vision in profoundly blind patients. In essence, they are creating artificial vision. RAZOR's Gabrielle Lawrence meets the lead scientist Professor Eduardo Fernandez and hears from some of the patients involved in the study. These cutting-edge implants are designed to stimulate the retina or visual cortex, allowing users to perceive shapes, light, and potentially even detailed images. This pioneering work represents a major step forward in the field of neuroprosthetics and offers renewed hope for millions living with vision loss.

programme.title: RAZOR: Huawei Norway Salmon
programme.desc: Norway's fjords and rivers are home to the iconic wild Atlantic salmon, but its population has fallen by half since the 1980s and now faces a growing threat from invasive Pacific pink salmon. Along the Tana River, locals have built traditional fish traps to intercept and manually sort the intruders, while new technology offers fresh hope in smaller rivers. Under its TECH4ALL initiative, Huawei, together with partners like the Berlevag Hunting and Fishing Association, has developed an AI-powered filtering system using underwater cameras, 5G, and solar power to identify fish with over 99% accuracy, diverting invasive salmon into holding tanks while letting native species pass freely. In 2023 alone, the system removed more than 6,000 pink salmon, cut manual labor by 90%, and avoided harm to native fish — a model now set to scale across Norway and potentially worldwide.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Xinjiang's role in Eurasia connectivity
programme.desc: From the bustling lanes of the world's largest bazaar in Urumqi to the humming logistics hubs at the region's 19 ports, Xinjiang is transforming its geographical advantage into economic strength. As China's gateway to the west, it now hosts a major network for opening-up, including the pioneering Pilot Free Trade Zone. This episode explores how cross-border trade, a web of China-Europe freight trains, and cultural exchanges are weaving Xinjiang into the very heart of the Belt and Road Initiative, making it a pivotal hub for continental connectivity.

programme.title: From Economic Corridors to Space Cooperation: Where are China-Pakistan Ties Heading?
programme.desc: On the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations, Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif completed a visit to China. The two countries deepened strategic mutual trust, advanced the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor 2.0, and signed cooperation agreements to boost trade, agriculture, education, and media cooperation. What opportunities will the upgraded CPEC unlock? How do cultural and people-to-people exchanges connect young people from both sides? Why does cooperation in space embody profound mutual trust? Host Xu Yawen is joined by Mahnoor Makhdoom, a Journalist at Daily Mail Pakistan; Muhammad Zamir Assadi, the Director of the China Desk at Lord Media Network; and Ali.TM, Chief Editor and Podcast Host with Othernews.pk for in-depth discussions.

programme.title: Inside the token surge: Where does the money flow in AI?
programme.desc: From "OpenClaw" to open-source AI agents, token demand is exploding. But where's the real money? CGTN x top AI experts on the AI gold rush, key players, and the inside track on where the money flows. Listen now.

programme.title: Meet China: Flying into the Future, Growing a Greener City, and Connecting Business to the World
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how the future is taking shape across different corners of China and beyond. From Guangzhou's rising low-altitude economy powered by electric flying cars, to Xiamen's practical path toward zero-carbon urban life, we see how innovation is changing the way people live and cities grow. We also step into China's booming livestream shopping culture, where commerce becomes community, and travel to Malaysia's rice fields, where Chinese agricultural expertise is helping improve harvests and food security. This episode reveals how technology, industry and creativity are turning bold ideas into everyday reality.

programme.title: Discovering Guizhou: Miao culture extravaganza
programme.desc: What do spicy peppers, handmade guitars, and green cities have in common? Guizhou. In our new on-the-ground mini-series ChinaHorizons, we invite you to join our trip to Guizhou province. For the first stop, we record our podcast in a traditional Miao people's village cluster to appreciate diversified cultures, intangible cultural heritage items and delicious local cuisines.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI talent race and the future of work
programme.desc: As artificial intelligence (AI) transforms industries worldwide, competition in AI is increasingly driven not only by technology, but also by talent, skills and workforce development. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN's Lily Lyu speaks with industry leaders and universities, to explore how AI is reshaping talent demand across industries, and how China is building a broader AI talent pipeline for the future.

programme.title: China's rural CEO experiment: How a Dai village is reinventing itself
programme.desc: During the Dai New Year, CGTN reporter Lincoln Humphries visited Manluanzhan, a traditional Dai village near China's southwestern border in Yunnan Province. There, "sleeping" assets are being awakened: an abandoned water tower has been turned into a café, and traditional Dai houses have been expanded to offer new types of homestays. At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward. In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Xinjiang's role in Eurasia connectivity
programme.desc: From the bustling lanes of the world's largest bazaar in Urumqi to the humming logistics hubs at the region's 19 ports, Xinjiang is transforming its geographical advantage into economic strength. As China's gateway to the west, it now hosts a major network for opening-up, including the pioneering Pilot Free Trade Zone. This episode explores how cross-border trade, a web of China-Europe freight trains, and cultural exchanges are weaving Xinjiang into the very heart of the Belt and Road Initiative, making it a pivotal hub for continental connectivity.

programme.title: From Economic Corridors to Space Cooperation: Where are China-Pakistan Ties Heading?
programme.desc: On the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations, Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif completed a visit to China. The two countries deepened strategic mutual trust, advanced the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor 2.0, and signed cooperation agreements to boost trade, agriculture, education, and media cooperation. What opportunities will the upgraded CPEC unlock? How do cultural and people-to-people exchanges connect young people from both sides? Why does cooperation in space embody profound mutual trust? Host Xu Yawen is joined by Mahnoor Makhdoom, a Journalist at Daily Mail Pakistan; Muhammad Zamir Assadi, the Director of the China Desk at Lord Media Network; and Ali.TM, Chief Editor and Podcast Host with Othernews.pk for in-depth discussions.

programme.title: Inside the token surge: Where does the money flow in AI?
programme.desc: From "OpenClaw" to open-source AI agents, token demand is exploding. But where's the real money? CGTN x top AI experts on the AI gold rush, key players, and the inside track on where the money flows. Listen now.

programme.title: Meet China: Flying into the Future, Growing a Greener City, and Connecting Business to the World
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how the future is taking shape across different corners of China and beyond. From Guangzhou's rising low-altitude economy powered by electric flying cars, to Xiamen's practical path toward zero-carbon urban life, we see how innovation is changing the way people live and cities grow. We also step into China's booming livestream shopping culture, where commerce becomes community, and travel to Malaysia's rice fields, where Chinese agricultural expertise is helping improve harvests and food security. This episode reveals how technology, industry and creativity are turning bold ideas into everyday reality.

programme.title: Discovering Guizhou: Miao culture extravaganza
programme.desc: What do spicy peppers, handmade guitars, and green cities have in common? Guizhou. In our new on-the-ground mini-series ChinaHorizons, we invite you to join our trip to Guizhou province. For the first stop, we record our podcast in a traditional Miao people's village cluster to appreciate diversified cultures, intangible cultural heritage items and delicious local cuisines.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Global Business-American Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet!

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong — Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres—including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs—they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group’s cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

programme.title: Time travel in Shunde: From ancient ancestral halls to dim sum
programme.desc: Two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia embarked on a journey to the historic Yang'e Village in Shunde, Guangdong Province. There, they savored authentic morning tea, visited ancient ancestral halls to appreciate the architectural grace and clan heritage of Lingnan, and experienced intangible cultural heritage to the rhythm of lion dance drums.

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou’s counties. From geological wonders and daring cliffside stunts at the Yandang Mountains, to rafting along the scenic Nanxi River, to harvesting seaweed and shellfish on the mud flats of the Dongtou Islands, Tianran discovers the ingenious ways the people of Wenzhou have transformed the challenges of living between mountains and seas into their greatest strengths.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious?figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Inner Mongolia’s Frozen Wonderland
programme.desc: In this episode, we feature the Winter Nadam Fair and winter sports in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia. By late December, the Hulunbuir Grassland is blanketed in ice and snow. Even in the bitter cold of around 30 degrees below zero, the grassland is alive with a festive bustle.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Exploring the Long Winter
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Jingpo Lake, Xuexiang and Yabuli in Mudanjiang, showcasing the unique winter ice fishing festival, the fairytale-like scenery of Xuexiang, and its world-class ski resorts.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game "Sifu" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to "eat porridge at night"

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

programme.title: Indigo Dreams: A Hue of Dali Tie-dye
programme.desc: Dali Tie-dye is the unique textile art of the Bai people, renowned for its exquisite hand-tying and traditional indigo dyeing techniques that create brilliant, one-of-a-kind patterns. Explore the cultural heritage and enduring beauty of this ancient craft from Yunnan.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: Bird-eye China Ep.1
programme.desc: Unfolding between the Kunlun, Altai and Tianshan ranges, cradling two vast basins, lies a beautiful land: Xinjiang. Join us on an aerial journey as we ascend the Tianshan to reveal the life-giving secrets of its crystal clear waters, before touching the summit of Bogda Peak, towering 5 km above sea-level, and gliding over the glittering, gem-like Tianchi Lake and the boundless grasslands that extend far beyond what even a bird’s eye can see into the west….

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

A pesar de que paga generosamente para ser ubicado en el sector VIP de la prisión, es llevado al sector más peligroso y terrible, donde debe luchar por sobrevivir.

programme.desc: Es Navidad y la nieve cubre cada rincón de un apacible pueblo. Sin embargo, la tragedia empieza cuando un terrorífico meteorito se estrella y amenaza con dejar congelada a toda la población, convirtiendo la blanca Navidad en una pesadilla de hielo.

programme.title: 12 Catástrofes
programme.desc: El día que Jacey cumple 18 años empiezan a suceder cosas extrañas: el agua se vuelve roja, tornados aparecen de la nada y punzantes lanzas de hielo caen del cielo. Pronto se da cuenta que ella es la única que tiene el poder de detener la fatalidad inminente. Usando un antiguo libro de profecías mayas y con la ayuda de su padre, Jacey buscará la manera de frenar los doce desastres que han activado la cuenta atrás para el fin del mundo.

programme.title: Vacaciones en el Infierno
programme.desc: Detenido y encarcelado en una prisión mexicana por tráfico de drogas, un hombre aprende a sobrevivir en este entorno hostil con la ayuda de un niño de 9 años.

programme.title: USS Seaviper
programme.desc: El submarino alemán, U-234, del puerto de Kiel está intercambiando carga con los japoneses. USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio.

programme.title: Planet Dune V2
programme.desc: Una tripulación en misión para salvar una base abandonada en un planeta desértico se convierte en mortal cuando son acechados y atacados por los principales depredadores del planeta: gusanos de arena gigantes.

programme.title: Rabia
programme.desc: Una mujer desarrolla el gusto por la sangre humana después de una cirugía plástica experimental, y sus víctimas se convierten en zombis sedientos de sangre, lo que lleva a una epidemia en toda la ciudad.

programme.title: Asalto sin límite
programme.desc: Es una vida sucia y rentable de crimen para los ladrones de coches conocidos como «choppers». Se necesita velocidad, valor y saber hacer, pero si a eso le añadimos un asesinato y un policía encubierto, la cosa puede ponerse explosiva.

programme.title: La espada del asesino
programme.desc: Nguyen Vu es el único sobreviviente de su familia que fue ejecutada por la emperatriz de Vietnam. Descubre que tal atrocidad fue motivada tras ser acusados por delitos que no cometieron y se propone hacer justicia y limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: El tren de la muerte
programme.desc: Un tren con rehenes es robado en Bremen, Alemania. Se dirige al sur de Europa con una bomba nuclear. Un grupo especial de lucha contra el crimen de la ONU se encarga de detenerlo en cooperación con militares y policías locales.

programme.title: Esto no es un atracto
programme.desc: Dos chicos de instituto que no consiguen ligar son víctimas de una broma de dos chicas.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre conduce su moto por el desierto, unos matones le roban el vehículo y lo dan por muerto. Sobrevive y ya no piensa en el suicidio, porque ahora tiene un objetivo en la vida: vengarse y recuperar su moto.

programme.title: Yatterman
programme.desc: La hermosa y ultra sexy Doronjo y sus malvados esbirros, sedientos de dinero, fama y poder, intentan recuperar los pedazos de una legendaria piedra con poderes misteriosos. Pero sus planes se verán interrumpidos por Gan, Ai y su fiel perro robot gigante, quienes iniciarán una frenética carrera contrarreloj para impedir que la gema caiga en manos de los villanos.

programme.title: Experimento Filadelfia
programme.desc: El intento por recrear un antiguo experimento secreto del gobierno fracasa y provoca un agujero espaciotemporal que hace que reaparezca el USS Eldridge, un acorazado de la Segunda Guerra Mundial que desapareció hace más de 70 años. Solo el único superviviente de la nave, acompañado por su nieta, una brillante científica, podrá detener la embarcación antes de que destroce el planeta.

programme.title: Megalodon Rising
programme.desc: Cuando el mayor depredador acuático de la historia regresa, la armada de modernos buques de guerra enviada para destruirlo no tiene ninguna posibilidad.

programme.title: El Hombre del Presidente
programme.desc: Un agente secreto altamente clasificado del presidente de Estados Unidos debe encontrar un intrépido sustituto que se haga cargo de sus peligrosísimas misiones militares.

programme.title: Yeti : Terreur en Montagne
programme.desc: Des amis partent à l'aventure dans la neige et tombent nez à nez avec une créature mortelle.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l’établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l’aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l’alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l’empire criminel d’Ik-ho.

programme.title: Crash lunaire
programme.desc: Deux entreprises, l'une sidérurgique et l'autre aérospatiale, décident de s'associer afin d'exploiter les ressources de la Lune. Mais, un accident de forage provoque une fissure et précipite un morceau de l'astre sélène vers la Terre.

programme.title: Le Jour de La Colère
programme.desc: Espagne, au XVIe siècle pendant l'Inquisition. Une série de meurtres particuliers secoue le pays. Le shérif Ruy de Mendoza mène l'enquête...

programme.title: Grid Runners
programme.desc: Un scientifique donne vie à des personnages de réalité virtuelle. Deux d'entre eux sont des femmes du site de jeu cybersexe. Le troisième est un guerrier qui veut libérer le reste des méchants du monde souterrain de la réalité virtuelle. Un policier des frontières doit vaincre le guerrier de la réalité virtuelle tout en apprenant à se comporter avec l'une des femmes du cybersexe.

programme.title: Le Meurtrier
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller d'action haletant, un chauffeur de taxi de Yanji, dans la préfecture autonome coréenne de Yanbian, au nord-est de la Chine, se rend en Corée du Sud à la demande d'un gangster local qui lui propose d'éliminer un professeur en échange du remboursement de sa dette. Parallèlement, il recherche sa femme, venue le rejoindre mais sans nouvelles depuis six mois. Ses soupçons d'infidélité le rongent, jusqu'à ce qu'un événement inattendu survienne cette nuit-là. Alors qu'il s'apprête à tuer le professeur, il se retrouve bientôt en fuite, traqué par la police et la mafia, donnant lieu à de violents combats et à d'intenses courses-poursuites.

programme.title: Héritage
programme.desc: Lors d'un voyage de chasse dans la région sauvage isolée, un père et son fils adolescent adoptif sont transformés en proies d'agresseurs inconnus. Ils sont rejoints dans leur lutte pour la survie par un étranger qui révèle la troublante vérité sur le père biologique du fils, un seigneur du crime international, et pourquoi ce seigneur du crime a envoyé des assassins entraînés pour tuer l'adolescent.

programme.title: Hercules Reborn
programme.desc: La fiancée d'un jeune homme est kidnappée par un roi impitoyable, Hercule est appelé à l'aide. En exil depuis des années, le guerrier retrouve l'espoir à travers l'amour du garçon pour sa bien-aimée. Ensemble, ils vont combattre le tyran.

programme.title: The eXtremists
programme.desc: Une équipe de tournage se rend dans les Alpes autrichiennes, près de l’ancienne frontière yougoslave, pour filmer trois passionnés de sports extrêmes poursuivis par une avalanche pour une publicité. Ce qu’ils ignorent, c’est qu’ils tournent à proximité de la cachette secrète de Slobodan Pavle, un criminel de guerre serbe. L’ayant accidentellement filmé, ils se retrouvent entraînés dans une course-poursuite mortelle à travers les montagnes, mêlant ski, snowboard, parachutisme, rafting, hélicoptères, motos et base jump.

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: Manipulation Criminelle
programme.desc: Theo Abrams est un ancien pompier du Cap souffrant d'un grave syndrome de stress post-traumatique, incapable de reprendre le travail en raison du traumatisme psychologique subi lors d'une mission de sauvetage qui a mal tourné. De plus en plus frustré et instable, Theo voit son monde basculer lorsqu'un matin, il se réveille à côté du cadavre de sa femme, sans aucun souvenir de ce qui s'est passé et avec toutes les preuves suggérant qu'il l'a tuée.

programme.title: Swim
programme.desc: Une famille est prise au piège alors que la maison de vacances qu'elle loue est inondée par la pluie et qu'un requin agressif a réussi à s'y introduire.

programme.title: A Battle of Wits
programme.desc: L'histoire est centrée sur une bataille qui s'est déroulée pendant la période des États combattants en Chine, une série de guerres civiles qui s'est étendue du 5e au 3e siècle avant J.-C. Basée sur un manga japonais populaire, elle était elle-même basée sur un roman japonais inspiré de l'histoire des États combattants en Chine

programme.title: Entre Dios y el Diablo
programme.desc: Un hombre accede al mapa de un tesoro y convence a un guía (Juan Chasquisdo) para que le acompañe en su búsqueda para recuperarlo. Ambos son perseguidos por bandidos.

programme.title: Erode Il Grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.desc: Después de tres años de trabajos forzados, Ted Barnett se fuga de la cárcel para vengarse de los tres hombres que le inculparon.

programme.desc: Cuando un veterano negro de la Guerra Civil se convierte en copropietario del rancho sureño de los McMasters, los indignados veteranos confederados locales vienen a por él y su esposa india.

programme.title: La Spada E La Croce

programme.title: Piena Di Grazia

Lo que la película ofrece es una multitud de piezas del rompecabezas que completan la historia, no sólo acerca de por qué ocurrió el tiroteo, sino la historia real de lo que condujo a ella y lo que siguió.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: This time Tianran and Hannah are in the scenic city of Shaoguan in northern Guangdong, where northern and southern culinary traditions converge. There, they’ll sample rare teas from the Danxia landscape, savor mountain-grown dishes, and visit the great Hakka enclosures, learning how the history of migration has shaped the way people eat and drink. After trying their hand at making ancient-style rice noodles, they end their journey at a thousand-year-old temple, where the spirit of Zen tea brings their exploration to a peaceful close.

programme.title: Lancang-Mekong: The River That Flows South Ep.3
programme.desc: This documentary follows 24 families along the Lancang-Mekong River—their lives, their connections, and the quiet ways they remain independent yet bound to one another. What emerges is a portrait of shared wisdom, shaped by the river and passed down for generations.

programme.title: Our Wild Neighbors Ep.1
programme.desc: This film turns its lens to the wild animals living in our cities. It's a story about conservation that also asks a deeper question: what kind of city do we want to build, and what kind of planning and design will create a better life for people while leaving room for everyone else? Perhaps by reimagining urban development, there is a way for humans and nature to truly coexist.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The sun heats the Earth, and life begins again. As they prepare to breed, animals wake from hibernation and build nests in treetops and caves. Whether reptiles, birds, or mammals, all the spring babies fight for survival through their first, most challenging days.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: These are the days of thirst: it is hot. Only the mountains are cool; everywhere else suffers in heat between 40 and 50°C. The rain is long forgotten. Each day is a search for shade and water. Amphibians bury themselves in mud to escape dehydration. The rest of the wild must wait for the cool of the night to move.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Reproduction is not only a concern of the young and restless: this episode of Aging in the Wild brings a light-hearted look at the issue of sexuality and camaraderie in older animals. We illustrate, for example, the link between the age of an elephant and its reproductive success. What are the reproductive benefits of these animals as they grow older? Through hearing their stories, we learn of some of the advantages - and disadvantages - of late-life reproduction.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Observing two massive elk clashing their antlers is to witness a true demonstration of power. For other species, such as the European marmot, remaining in power is a matter of collaborating with family and community. Are these animals forced to give up their hard-won social status as they age? Through this lens, we take a deep and entertaining look at the challenges faced by those in power ... and what it takes to stay there.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In many human cultures, elders play a vital role in the well-being of communities and are responsible for passing down knowledge and culture. Is it any wonder to find that the orca, the elephant, and the wolf, have been found to transmit their respective cultures to the younger generations? Young animals learn by observing their elders. Judging when to fight or take flight, deciding how to choose a life partner, learning where to find food, these are just some of the skills passed down through the generations as elders share their wisdom.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.
